_fixture_note: TEST FIXTURE — NOT RESEARCHED CONTENT, NOT FOR PUBLICATION. Written by hand for one purpose: the three render-test scripts exercise 12 of the 16 registered visual strategies, leaving DATA_CHART, RELATIONSHIP, SCALE_COMPARISON and IMAGE_EVIDENCE with no rendered evidence at all. A strategy that has never been rendered is a strategy nobody has checked. Every figure below is ILLUSTRATIVE and was invented to trigger a detector, not researched. Deliberately NOT under data/research/ — this repo's grounding rule (CLAUDE.md) forbids presenting invented numbers as researched, so this file must never reach TTS, publish, or a channel's research directory. The `enumeration` section was added later, for the same reason: ENUMERATION replaced the LIST_ITEM card fallback and no motion-graphics script in the repo produces a consecutive list run, so it had no rendered evidence either. Its role names are invented like everything else here. IMAGE_EVIDENCE is not covered here because it needs a real sourced photograph; a fixture cannot supply one without fabricating provenance, so it stays uncovered and is reported as such.
hook: Three things the numbers show once you put them side by side.

sections.voiceover: Across the four regions the figures were forty in the north, sixty five in the south, thirty in the east and ninety in the west.
The regulator, the clearing house, the custodian bank and the exchange all depend on each other, and each one is connected to every other.
Seventy percent of the entire field was taken up by that single holding, and the rest was split between everyone else.
First, the harbour master. Then, the customs officer. Next, the warehouse keeper. Finally, the shipping clerk.
